# Jay Liu

> Jay Liu (Jie Liu) is a senior software engineer based in Auckland, New Zealand, interested in enterprise AI integration, senior software engineering and forward deployed engineering. His experience includes ERP/CRM, retail software, healthcare systems and delivery-focused financial-platform work at FNZ. His independent projects cover AI agents, knowledge retrieval and speech processing. The homepage presents four cases with responsibilities, engineering decisions and current evidence, followed by career experience and capabilities. FDE is an area of interest, not a past job title.

## Public website

- [English portfolio](https://jayliu.co.nz/): Concrete project cases, background, skills, experience and contact details.
- [Simplified Chinese portfolio](https://jayliu.co.nz/zh/): Chinese version of the same personal portfolio.
- [Project collection](https://jayliu.co.nz/projects/): All 30 project examples, stages, small previews and public links.
- [Simplified Chinese project collection](https://jayliu.co.nz/zh/projects/): Chinese version of the complete collection.
- [Privacy](https://jayliu.co.nz/privacy/): How this website and contact links handle information.
- [Traditional Chinese portfolio](https://jayliu.co.nz/zh-hant/): Traditional Chinese homepage, with project and privacy counterparts.
- [Japanese portfolio](https://jayliu.co.nz/ja/): Japanese version of the same facts and projects.
- [French portfolio](https://jayliu.co.nz/fr/): French version of the same facts and projects.
- [Korean portfolio](https://jayliu.co.nz/ko/): Korean version of the same facts and projects.

Jay is a volunteer AI Coach for HiLily, providing technical guidance; its team reports a functional MVP preparing for pilots. The accounting assistant prepares records and exports for human review. CodexView is publicly inspectable source. The enterprise CRM is an internal system. FNZ client assignments and implementations are confidential; independent AI work is not attributed to FNZ.

Previews are small redacted screenshots or labelled AI-generated interface illustrations. Private previews contain no customer records or private endpoints. The homepage and project collection include a link to the existing public CV. Email and LinkedIn provide direct contact; the site does not collect form submissions or run analytics.
